title: runstate v0.6 lifecycle convention
description: Pins the bodies of the lifecycle.* topics (log format 0.4.0; docs/specs/commits-and-lineage.md section 3): started (the claim: who computes, where it starts, which names are sources), commit (a lineage node, one per commit()), heartbeat (liveness only, not a node), rewind (restates the position), stopped (the worker's exit, always a node), nak (a refused control request), bound (a lease bound to its claim). Applied on top of the envelope schema. Every lifecycle record carries name null. request_id is the launch id on started (null for a launcher-less run), the request on bound and nak, and null on commit, heartbeat, rewind and stopped. Present-nullable throughout: every field is present, null or [] when not applicable. CONSTRAINTS THE SCHEMA CANNOT CHECK (spec section 3, 'The fields', marked prose): (1) resume_from, on started and rewind, names an extendable node of this run below its record's own seq; (2) parent, on commit and stopped, names an extendable node and equals the claim's position (before a commit; at the exit for stopped); (3) every seq in values is lower than the record's own seq; (4) every request id in fired names a source subscription the claim had registered; (5) a request in expired fires at no later node of that lineage. Also outside the schema: a seq named twice along one lineage is malformed, and an extendable/closed/torn judgment of a node is made from the log, not the body alone.

Parent.description: The shared type of `parent`: the seq of a node, or null (the first node after a fresh start or a rewind to the root).

Values.description: The shared type of `values`: unique seqs >= 1, order significant (the writer's own order). No maxItems. On stopped it is wrapped as nullable.

Requests.description: The shared type of `fired` and `expired` (and, as a set of names, of `sources`): unique, non-empty strings.

Started.description: The claim: who computes (handle, the worker's self-reported liveness handle), when (t, the run epoch), where it starts (resume_from: an extendable node of this run, or null: no node of this run: a fresh start, or state no node of the run holds, such as a checkpoint from outside it), and which names it exposes as sources, sampled on demand (sources: [] declares none). Prose: resume_from names an extendable node below this record's seq.

Commit.description: A lineage node, one per commit(). claim_seq names the claim it speaks for; consumed_seq is the control-drain watermark; parent is the claim's position before it; values are the seqs it commits; fired the subscriptions that fired here; expired those whose schedule ended here. Prose: parent names an extendable node and equals the claim's position; every seq in values is lower than the record's own; each fired names a source subscription the claim registered.

Heartbeat.description: Liveness only; not a node. step is removed. claim_seq names the episode the beat speaks for; consumed_seq is the control-drain watermark; t dates the beacon.

Rewind.description: Restates the position only: where, never who. resume_from is an extendable node of this run, or null for the root. Prose: resume_from names an extendable node below this record's seq.

Stopped.description: The worker's exit, always a node; at most one per claim. completed=true is the worker's claim of intrinsic completion (a closed node); a completed stop carries no error. error non-null implies values null. values is null when the exit discarded its open iteration (a torn exit if it did not complete), and then fired and expired are []; otherwise the pending values then the samples, [] if none. claim_seq names the episode it ends (never null). honored names the control.stop request_ids it honored, each non-empty, since no request id is empty. parent is the position at the exit. Prose: parent names an extendable node and equals the position at the exit; every seq in values is lower than the record's own; each fired names a source subscription the claim registered.

Bound.description: A lease (a subscription with a time or count atom), named by the envelope request_id, bound to the episode claim_seq names. Unchanged from lifecycle-v0.5.

Nak.description: A refused control request, correlated by request_id. reason is a closed enum: malformed, unsatisfiable, unsupported. message is free human detail. Unchanged from lifecycle-v0.5.
